title: The Salafi Woman
description: Rights, responsibilities and virtues of Muslim women upon the methodology of the Salaf: the 40 Hadith on women, careers and public life, beautification, spousal rights, and the women scholars of Islam. Lessons from AMAU Academy (Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan, Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble) and Umm Uthmaan al-Majariyyah. An AMAU women's hadith series is paired with the classic lectures of the Salafi sisters.
short_description: The role and rights of Muslim women upon the Salafi methodology
